summary: ChatGPT sits **#5** in the frontier-model pack on share of voice, only **0.018** behind **Claude**. But counted as one house, the OpenAI family (ChatGPT + OpenAI) combines for **0.111 SoV**, enough that it **would top the category**. The race is **winnable**.

The real issue is quality and concentration, not headline rank. AI engines describe us **net-negatively (-403)** while they describe Claude **positively**. The visibility gap is widest on **Microsoft Copilot**, where we trail by **20 points**, not on ChatGPT itself.

actions.text: review the **sentiment gap (-403)** and the themes driving it: **privacy concerns, data privacy concerns**.
